claims: Wout van Aert (Visma-Lease a Bike) won the 123rd edition of the men's Paris-Roubaix on April 12, 2026.
Wout van Aert secured his first victory in the "Hell of the North".
Wout van Aert outsprinted Tadej Pogačar (UAE Team Emirates) in the Roubaix velodrome.
The 2026 men's Paris-Roubaix was 258.3 kilometers long.
The 2026 men's Paris-Roubaix started in Compiègne.
The 2026 men's Paris-Roubaix ended at the Roubaix Velodrome.
Tadej Pogačar was the runner-up in the 2026 men's Paris-Roubaix.
Tadej Pogačar utilized a 1x drivetrain during the 2026 Paris-Roubaix.
Tadej Pogačar utilized wide 38mm tyres during the 2026 Paris-Roubaix.
Tadej Pogačar dealt with punctures during the 2026 Paris-Roubaix.
Wout van Aert dealt with punctures during the 2026 Paris-Roubaix.
Paris-Roubaix is often referred to as "The Hell of the North".
Paris-Roubaix is often referred to as "Queen of the Classics".
Paris-Roubaix is one of cycling’s one-day "Monument" races.
Paris-Roubaix Femmes is the women's edition held annually in early April.
Barry-Roubaix is a gravel race in Michigan.
Boulder Roubaix is a road race in Colorado.
Ruby Roubaix is a gravel fondo-style race.
